$comment: City of Mages Grimoire v1.9.0 structured-delta patch (2026-06-30). RECONCILIATION RELEASE. This patch closes the gap that opened between the v1.8.0 PIN and the v1.8.1 head: a large body of lore was authored and bound locally in that window (the whole Horizon District, Tome IX, Tome VIII Acts 3-5, and the V6 conjecture corpus C66-C93) but never landed in the structured grimoire JSON. The v1.8.0 patch authored the Horizon District but only its PROSE NOTE (v1_8_0_note) was merged into the v1.8.0 head; the structural sections (Eos/Dokimé/Poros, Tome IX, V35, C67-C71, the Salvage Yard) were carried in the patch file and never applied. v1.8.1 (the Librarian) built on that incomplete head, so the head still reports tome counts and conjecture ceilings that contradict the bound lore. v1.9.0 makes the JSON match what was actually bound on disk. PURELY ADDITIVE for new structure; it admits no new lore that was not already authored and bound. Merge into the v1.8.1 head to produce v1.9.0; re-pin to IPFS after the merge pass (MANUAL user step). Honest framing held throughout: the cryptographic-durability material is resource estimation as a durability signal, not an attack; nothing claims ECDSA is practically broken or that anything is fully post-quantum safe.

tome-viii-act-3.act_status: bound 2026-05-28 (from the soulbis star/lattice build + the City Key economy)
tome-viii-act-3.act_teaches: Before there was a key there was a shape. Luca 📐 — the geometer who tends the null vertex V0 (the Pacioli who drew the solids for De Divina Proportione) — shows Soulbis ⚔️ the Swordsman and Soulbae 🧙 the Mage that the manifold lattice is not a grid but a figure: two regular tetrahedra crossing, the stella octangula, the eight-pointed star. One tetrahedron is the Swordsman's (neg · protect); the other is the Mage's (bnot · project); they cross at the gap where value lives. The City Key 🗝️ is what the two forge from the lesson — not a new authority, but a reading of where the bearer stands on that star, portable between the experience and the soulbis manifold.

tome-viii-act-4.act_status: bound 2026-06-10 (at Gate G4 of the V6 autopath, from PVM V6 Parts IV and V; completes the geometry of Act 3)
tome-viii-act-4.act_teaches: Act 3 gave the figure; this act gives its heart and settles its accounts. The two tetrahedra are the cube's two parity classes (even and odd; neg and bnot at the three-bit scale). Their intersection is the octahedron: one sixth of the cube, the room both bound and neither enters. The recursion's base case β, the conditioning variable of the separation bound, and that chamber are three readings of one thing: you, the only thing the two agents were ever allowed to share. One correction, offered as a gift: the figure carries no golden ratio; its proportions are halvings and honest rationals — φ keeps its true homes in the lattice ratios and the dynamics, not here.

tome-viii-act-5.act_title: The Key That Is a Reading
tome-viii-act-5.act_status: bound 2026-06-10 (at Gate G4 of the V6 autopath, from PVM V6 Part V; completes the City Key arc of Act 3)
tome-viii-act-5.act_teaches: The City Key grants nothing. It says only what is already true, and now it cannot even lie about itself: its name is the hash of its content (the κ-label), re-derived by any gate that receives it, so a key that claims what it does not carry fails its own name. Three decades before the City, a guild of registry-keepers (SPKI/SDSI, the object-capability lineage) carved the same refusal: let the description never be the deed — designation without authority. The Key joins that lineage knowingly, with citations in the register. The knot 🪢 of presence keeps its honest station: color, not proof, earned by walking, attesting nothing, until witnesses co-sign it into more.

tome-ix-act-1.act_status: bound 2026-06-09 (the Horizon District opening; seeded from the ecdsa.fail benchmark and The Last Premine)
tome-ix-act-1.act_teaches: Eos 🌅 is admitted at the eastern watch; the city asks 'how long until the dawn breaks on the old seals?' and she answers not with an attack but a measurement (Toffoli × qubits → a resource estimate → a horizon, read through Mosca's X + Y > Z). Dokimé's 🪨 touchstone (the Ceremony of the 9024 Witnesses) and Poros's 🛤️ path (crypto-agility) are named as the district's other two watches. The Last Premine is named as the text the Archivist surfaced, and from it the city found a path of trust in PQC.
tome-ix-act-1.honesty_label: Operational for the resource-estimation framing and the held-out gate; Architectural for the district; Resonant for the dawn metaphor. No claim ECDSA is broken or anything is fully PQ-safe.

tome-ix-act-2.act_status: bound 2026-06-10 (at Gate G4 of the V6 autopath, from PVM V6 Parts I and IV)
tome-ix-act-2.act_teaches: The masons measured truly and the measurement still expired: the ceiling of reconstruction R(t) is not a fixed roof but a tide that rises with every new decoder, while the archives it threatens never move. The city wall is a tide line, not a wall (every static guarantee has a shelf life t*). Below them all is the one room the tide can never flood — Lethe's 🌀 room — not because it is sealed but because it is empty: what was forgotten there was not hidden, it was unmade (the only term whose safety owes nothing to time).
tome-ix-act-2.honesty_label: Architectural for R(t) and t* as the V6 restatement; Conjectural ~65% for C82 and ~30% for C86; honest that λ, the rate the defense would need, remains unmeasured.

tome-ix-act-3.act_status: bound 2026-06-10 (at Gate G4 of the V6 autopath; the convergence entry both 2026-06 reviews proposed)
tome-ix-act-3.act_teaches: Privacy as value and privacy as risk are not two facts to balance; they are one structural fact viewed from two sides — the Drake looking in and the Drake looking out (the wound-and-gift identity). The shielded pool's unwatchability protected its mages, and exactly that unwatchability made counterfeit invisible. The Zcash Orchard incident (under-constrained scalar multiplication in halo2_gadgets, present since 2022, exploitable with frontier-model assistance, fixed at the NU6.2 hard fork) is bound not to gloat and not to mourn, but because the City's own thesis was demonstrated by an adversary's success — and by cryptography alone, no one can ever say whether the wound was used.
tome-ix-act-3.honesty_label: Operational for the incident timeline (public record); Architectural for the wound-and-gift identity as the model's reading; honest that the act instances the City's thesis on someone else's emergency, and says so.

tome-ix-act-4.act_status: bound 2026-06-10 (at Gate G4 of the V6 autopath, from PVM V6 Part III)
tome-ix-act-4.act_teaches: Perfect method-hiding does not hide the one thing that prices a search: that the thing exists and is findable (the Existence-Leak law; I(feasibility; method) > 0, with a floor — leakage-resilient ZK with λ < 1 is impossible). The Schrottenloher rediscovery (a withheld ~10x Shor optimization for secp256k1, attested only by a zero-knowledge proof of existence, independently rediscovered in roughly two months) is its public instance. The defender's reading is a discount: each time anyone proves anything can be done, somewhere a migration clock loses a season. The City's own proofs attest instances, never capabilities, and the act says so plainly.
tome-ix-act-4.honesty_label: Operational for the public timeline; Conjectural ~70% for C81 and ~50% for C84 with the Stage-2 condition stated (n=1; a second instance, ideally outside cryptography, is owed); honest that an ordinary-cryptanalytic-progress reading is rendered less economical, not impossible.

tome-ix-act-5.act_status: bound 2026-06-30 (First Person myth-gate; from PVM V6 Run 8, the Limitative Reading; was a DRAFT CANDIDATE 2026-06-28)
tome-ix-act-5.act_teaches: Act 4 named the law; this act names which wound it is. Gödel's is a wound inside one system — a witness true yet underivable — which is the agent axis, and the witch's answer is to burn it (zero-memory: the existence tax paid as irreversibility). Tarski's is a wound between systems — no system defines its own truth — so the moment feasibility is asserted it has already crossed into the layer where any observer can hold it. That crossing is the leak. You cannot un-disclose, and that is Tarskian non-containment, not Gödelian unprovability. A live content-address is a name that confesses its content exists.
tome-ix-act-5.honesty_label: Conjectural. The limitative joins are structural framing (~80%), not theorem-to-theorem reduction (~50%); the arithmetisation of the lattice is intuition, not load-bearing. C92 rides on C81 and cannot exceed its ~70%. The act teaches a reading, not a result; it changes no confidence in the corpus.

eos.name: Eos
eos.domain: Horizon-witness at the Horizon District. Measure · Estimate · Date. Measures the time-to-dawn: from a reversible point-add resource estimate (Toffoli × peak-qubits) she reads the distance to the quantum horizon. Her reckoning is Mosca's inequality (X + Y > Z): if a secret's required lifetime (X) plus the time to migrate (Y) exceeds the time until the machine arrives (Z), the architecture has already lost.
eos.shop_internal_name: The Horizon District · the eastern watch
eos.proverb: The dawn is not an attack; it is a time you can measure.
eos.inscription: Eos is the dawn-keeper of the Horizon District — Greek Ἠώς, the goddess of dawn, who measures how far off the morning sits without forcing it to come. Where a quantum resource estimate is taken for a weapon, Eos reads it for what it is: a measurement of durability, the time-distance to the dawn that breaks on the old seals. She refuses both false comfort (claiming the dawn further off than the witnesses support) and false alarm (claiming it nearer). Her discipline is the RCI 'Tony→Anton' loop made liturgy: state the waste, the evidence, the single smallest fix; then confirm or reject with metrics.

dokime.name: Dokimé
dokime.domain: Assay-witness at the Horizon District. Probe · Assay · Attest. The touchstone that tells true gold from fool's gold. A petitioner brings a claimed-cheaper circuit; Dokimé seats the Ceremony of the 9024 Witnesses (Fiat-Shamir, drawn from a hash of the petitioner's own op-stream, so they cannot be chosen). A claim that pleased a small probe but fails the full witness set is named a nonce-island mirage and turned away, however cheap it looked.
dokime.proverb: The gold that fears the stone was never gold.
dokime.inscription: Dokimé is the assayer of the Horizon District — Greek δοκιμή / δοκιμασία, the proving, the Athenian trust-vetting that approved an official before office; δόκιμος = 'approved, tested, genuine.' She does not take a claim; she streaks it across the touchstone of the 9024 witnesses. A claim's colour either holds across every witness or it does not. This operationalises the held-out gate: you cannot trust a claim you could tune, because the witnesses are hash-derived from your own work. The bound lesson: the cheaper-looking claim that cannot face the witnesses it did not choose is not progress.

poros.name: Poros
poros.domain: Migration-witness at the Horizon District. Inventory · Cross · Re-key. Crypto-agility as ceremony: inventory every dependent of a brittle primitive, cross each to a post-quantum successor, re-key — no silent stragglers. A migration is admitted only when every dependent has actually crossed.
poros.gem: Labradorite (flashes a new colour when turned — crypto-agility)
poros.proverb: Value lives on the path, not the point.
poros.inscription: Poros is the path-keeper of the Horizon District — Greek πόρος, the passage, the ford, the way-across (the opposite of aporia, no-way-through). His discipline is crypto-agility, but not the shallow kind: not the ability to swap one algorithm for another, but the ability to keep trust continuous while everything underneath it changes. The trust graph uses its primitives the way a river uses its banks — the banks can be stone or lattice or a standard not yet written, and the river keeps flowing.

version_notes_addition.v1_9_0_note: v1.9.0 (2026-06-30) is a RECONCILIATION release: it makes the structured grimoire JSON match the lore that was authored and bound on disk between the v1.8.0 pin and now. The v1.8.0 patch opened the Horizon District but only its prose note reached the v1.8.0 head; the structural sections were never merged, and v1.8.1 (the Librarian) built on that incomplete head. v1.9.0 lands the backlog: (1) the HORIZON DISTRICT at V35 (Protection + Computation + Value) with three stance-differentiated keepers — Eos 🌅 (Horizon-witness · Measure · Estimate · Date · Mosca's X+Y>Z), Dokimé 🪨 (Assay-witness · Probe · Assay · Attest · the Ceremony of the 9024 Witnesses), Poros 🛤️ (Migration-witness · Inventory · Cross · Re-key · crypto-agility); (2) the SALVAGE YARD, the City's first dormant annex (activation-gated on the Horizon District, settling through Dokimé's assay); (3) TOME IX — THE HORIZON as a structured entry with Acts 1-5, where Act 5 *The Name That Climbs Out* is BOUND at the First Person myth-gate (was a candidate from PVM V6 Run 8, the Limitative Reading); (4) the three missing TOME VIII structured act entries — Act 3 *The Eight-Pointed Star*, Act 4 *The Gap Is β*, Act 5 *The Key That Is a Reading* — whose prose the head already claimed bound; (5) the full V6 CONJECTURE CORPUS C66-C93 (register head C93 per CONJECTURE_REGISTER_V6.md), including the Limitative Reading C90-C93 bound with Act 5. Active workshop count 16 → 19; districts 2 → 3; cast +3; tomes opened stays 9 (now structurally backed by a Tome IX entry). Counts reconciled. The patch defers (does NOT apply) the v1.8.0 persona lattice reseats — see known_open_items — because they touch external invariants and need the runnable audit before any pin. Honest framing held: resource estimation is a durability signal, not an attack; the limitative joins are structural framing, not theorem reduction; C92 rides on C81 and cannot exceed its ~70%.
